tables.title: Bayesian Independent Samples T-Test
notes: Prior: Cauchy on effect size δ with scale r = 0.707.

interpretation.text:
A Bayesian Independent Samples T-Test used a Cauchy prior with scale r = 0.707 on the standardized effect size.

For mpg, the data are 86.6 times more likely under H₁ (mpg is different between the groups) than under H₀ (no difference): BF₁₀ = 86.6, very strong evidence for H₁. The posterior median effect size is δ = −1.29, 95% credible interval [−2.14, −0.50].

title: Bayesian Independent Samples T-Test
code:
library(BayesFactor)
library(ggnext)
# Bayesian independent samples t-test: mpg by am
d <- subset(data, !is.na(mpg) & !is.na(am))
d$am <- factor(d$am, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Automatic", "Manual"))
desc <- aggregate(mpg ~ am, data = d, FUN = function(x)
  c(n = length(x), mean = mean(x), sd = sd(x), se = sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))))
rscale <- sqrt(2) / 2   # Cauchy prior width on the effect size delta
bf <- ttestBF(formula = mpg ~ am, data = d, rscale = rscale)
bf10 <- extractBF(bf)$bf
set.seed(123)
delta <- as.numeric(posterior(bf, iterations = 10000, progress = FALSE)[, "delta"])
# Prior and posterior density of delta
grid <- seq(min(-2, quantile(delta, 0.001)), max(2, quantile(delta, 0.999)), length.out = 400)
dens <- density(delta)
pp <- rbind(
  data.frame(delta = grid, density = approx(dens$x, dens$y, grid, yleft = 0, yright = 0)$y, Distribution = "Posterior"),
  data.frame(delta = grid, density = dcauchy(grid, 0, rscale), Distribution = "Prior"))
p_pp <- ggnext(pp, aes(delta, density, color = Distribution)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, dash = "4 4") +
  labs(title = "Prior and posterior: mpg", x = "Effect size (δ)", y = "Density") +
  theme_modern()
# Robustness check: the Bayes factor across prior widths
rob <- data.frame(r = seq(0.05, 1.5, by = 0.05))
rob$bf10 <- sapply(rob$r, function(r) extractBF(ttestBF(formula = mpg ~ am, data = d, rscale = r))$bf[1])
rob_user <- data.frame(r = rscale, bf10 = bf10)
p_rob <- ggnext(rob, aes(r, log10(bf10))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(data = rob_user, size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, dash = "4 4") +
  labs(title = "Bayes factor robustness: mpg", x = "Prior width (r)", y = "log10(BF₁₀)") +
  theme_modern()
